knownGaps: Recycle bin and tree on the wide contract. IAsyncContentRepository carries RecycleBinKey, GetRecycleBinAsync, GetPagedRecycleBinAsync, GetChildrenAsync, GetDescendantsAsync and GetRootContentAsync for every kind, matching NPoco. Members have no recycle bin (the NPoco MemberRepository throws from RecycleBinId) and no tree (every member sits under root). Decide at the cutover: split a tree-only interface out of IAsyncContentRepository with the recycle bin members on an intermediate tier that media and the publishable kinds inherit, or keep NPoco's throwing default. The version members (GetAllVersionsAsync, GetAllVersionsSlimAsync, GetVersionIdsAsync, GetVersionAsync, DeleteVersionAsync, DeleteVersionsAsync) are a second candidate band for the same split: every kind reads one version row, but only documents and elements keep history, IMemberService exposes no version member, and the NPoco MemberRepository's PerformDeleteVersion is a no-op.

Ordering fields. AsyncContentRepositoryBase.ApplyOrdering is a static switch over a fixed field list (name, dates, id, owner, updater, published, content type alias, path, sort order) and rejects anything else. The NPoco MemberRepository pages with its own ordering (member fields such as email and username) and its own rejection. Members need either an overridable ordering step on the wide base or their own paging path; add the hook before porting MemberRepository.GetPage.

By-level, ancestors and recycle-bin-smells are protected cores on the wide base (GetByLevelCoreAsync, GetAncestorsCoreAsync, RecycleBinSmellsCoreAsync), exposed only by IDocumentRepository and, from media PR 4, IAsyncMediaRepository. Members expose none of them.

easyWins.note: Small repositories that can go one PR at a time, in any order, outside a campaign. The first group needs no new DTO: every table it touches already has an EF Core DTO and configuration, so there is no migration or snapshot work. The second group needs one new DTO plus a no-op snapshot migration each. DataTypeUsageRepository and PropertyTypeUsageRepository were the first to go (#24780, 26-11-2026).
